'''Prender''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Prender kept a [[DF-D1 Duo-Flechette Rifle/Legends|duo-flechette rifle]] in a quick-access rig by the landing ramp of their [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
